Agent 1 claims Peter Pan and the Lost Boys live in the Hundred Acre Wood. This is incorrect - Peter Pan and the Lost Boys live in Neverland, not the Hundred Acre Wood. Despite the high confidence of 0.97, this is factually wrong.

Agents 2, 3, and 4 all correctly identify that Winnie-the-Pooh and his friends live in the Hundred Acre Wood. This is the fictional setting created by A.A. Milne for the Winnie-the-Pooh stories. The detailed answers from Agents 2 and 4 listing the specific characters (Christopher Robin, Piglet, Eeyore, Tigger, Rabbit, Kanga, Roo, Owl) are accurate.
